scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
...
......
向戰士們致敬。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
We are the warriors
of the desert. Nobody
looks down upon us.
Nobody...
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
我們是沙漠的戰士。
誰也不能輕視我們。
誰也不能...

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
The time has come.
The world needs you...
More than ever.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
時機已到。
世界需要你...比以往任何時候都更需要。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
I ask that you continue to live in the shadows, but as an even greater Assassin with a new appearance.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
希望你繼續隱身於暗影之中，以全新的姿態，成為更強大的刺客。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
Will you become
an Assassin Cross?
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
你願意成為十字刺客嗎？

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
When you are
ready, come back.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
準備好了，再回來吧。

[十字刺客]
向戰士們致敬。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
You still haven't
learned everything
that you can.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
你還有能學的技能尚未掌握。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
Use all your
Skill Points
and then come back.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
用完所有技能點，再回來。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
Congratulations.
As an Assassin Cross,
I hope that you fight for a brighter future within the darkness.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
恭喜。
願你身為十字刺客，在黑暗中為光明的未來而戰。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
歡迎來到榮耀之廳——英靈殿。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
在這裡安心休息吧。
向戰士們致敬。
